title: neatlogs, anthropic messages stream: top-level span status is OK

tries.explanation: When messages.stream() is used, _SyncStreamManagerWrapper.__exit__ and _AsyncStreamManagerWrapper.__aexit__ always call _finalize() which sets StatusCode.OK, even when an exception propagated through the context manager. The fix checks whether an exception was passed to __exit__/__aexit__ and, if so, records it as an error via _err() instead of calling _finalize().

"""Tests that messages.stream() sets ERROR status when the stream raises."""
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Iterator

import pytest
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.trace import StatusCode

from neatlogs._wrap_utils import set_neatlogs_provider
from neatlogs.anthropic import wrap_anthropic_client


class _FakeEvent:
    type = "content_block_delta"
    delta = SimpleNamespace(type="text_delta", text="hello")
    index = 0


class _ErrorOnIterStream:
    def __init__(self, error):
        self._error = error

    def __iter__(self):
        yield _FakeEvent()
        raise self._error

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        pass


class _ErrorOnFirstIterStream:
    def __init__(self, error):
        self._error = error

    def __iter__(self):
        raise self._error
        yield

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        pass


class _FakeStreamManager:
    def __init__(self, stream):
        self._stream = stream

    def __enter__(self):
        return self._stream

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        pass


class _FakeMessages:
    def __init__(self, stream_mgr):
        self._stream_mgr = stream_mgr

    def create(self, **kwargs):
        pass

    def stream(self, **kwargs):
        return self._stream_mgr


def _setup():
    provider = TracerProvider()
    exporter = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(exporter))
    set_neatlogs_provider(provider)
    return exporter


def _make_client(stream_mgr):
    messages = _FakeMessages(stream_mgr)
    client = SimpleNamespace(messages=messages, completions=None, beta=None)
    wrap_anthropic_client(client)
    return client


def test_stream_helper_cut_sets_error_status():
    exporter = _setup()
    error = RuntimeError("RemoteProtocolError: peer closed connection")
    client = _make_client(_FakeStreamManager(_ErrorOnIterStream(error)))

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="RemoteProtocolError"):
        with client.messages.stream(
            model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
            max_tokens=10,
        ) as events:
            for _ in events:
                pass

    spans = exporter.get_finished_spans()
    assert len(spans) == 1
    assert spans[0].name == "anthropic.messages.create"
    assert spans[0].status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR


def test_stream_helper_error_event_sets_error_status():
    exporter = _setup()
    error = ValueError("APIStatusError: 529 overloaded")
    client = _make_client(_FakeStreamManager(_ErrorOnFirstIterStream(error)))

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="APIStatusError"):
        with client.messages.stream(
            model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
            max_tokens=10,
        ) as events:
            for _ in events:
                pass

    spans = exporter.get_finished_spans()
    assert len(spans) == 1
    assert spans[0].name == "anthropic.messages.create"
    assert spans[0].status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR
